collected_via: browser (free web UI, async job API)
method: Qwen3-8B-Base (Q4_K_M) served by Ollama; scripts/hip.py, 2 passes, ~200-word chunks, temperature 0.9, top_p 0.95. Input: the same AI draft used in evals/voices/.
caveat: Probability, not verdict. Single run. One base model, one prompt, one detector, one sample.

signals: AI-like patterns are highly consistent at both sentence and full-text levels.

finding: The base-model HIP pass did not beat Clever. Qwen3-8B-Base output scored 97% AI, statistically identical to every instruction-tuned rewrite (97-99%). The 'base models read as human' finding (arXiv 2605.19516) was measured against GPTZero and Pangram, not Clever, and did not reproduce here. Clever flags LLM output broadly — both instruction-tuned and base-model. Genuinely human prose (3%) is the only thing that passed.
